title: EVALUATING PERSPECTIVAL BIASES IN CROSS-MODAL RETRIEVAL

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the divergence between expected and observed language distributions in image-to-text retrieval results using a rank-weighted metric called Discounted Language Bias Kullback-Leibler (DLBKL) divergence on the multilingual Crossmodal-3600 dataset.

Evaluating text-to-image retrieval using a forced-choice evaluation paradigm on a novel Cross-Cultural Multimodal (3XCM) benchmark, calculating a Self-Preference Cultural Bias Score (SP) to quantify a model's preference for culturally associated images over semantically faithful ones.
